name: Disciples
overview: The Scriptures reveal that discipleship involves a committed following of Christ characterized by self-denial and daily surrender, as Jesus calls believers to take up their cross and follow Him (Luke 9:23). True discipleship is marked by steadfastness in Jesus' word, which confirms one's identity as His disciple (John 8:31). Central to this calling is the command to love one another as Christ loved, demonstrating the transformative power of His love within the community of believers (John 13:34). Ultimately, making disciples entails teaching and baptizing all nations in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, fulfilling Christ's Great Commission to spread the gospel worldwide (Matthew 28:19).
